summary: Interface-bound tumor retreat with no internal notch shortcut.

rules.claim: Every changed pixel must convert Tumor to the resolved non-tumor target and no other pixel may change.
rules.required_observation: Compare source, target, and change region pixel by pixel.
counterexamples: Relabeling normal gland or background during tumor retreat.

rules.claim: The retreat must stay connected to a sufficiently broad selected interface and pass depth/span, area, topology, preservation, profile, and provenance checks.
rules.required_observation: Measure changed-pixel depth from the pre-edit interface and the interface contact span.
counterexamples: A 218-pixel-deep indentation grown from a short edge.
known_limitations: Thresholds must be recalibrated on expert-reviewed edits.
